a1-ferment-sec.heading: ZeoCharge & Ferment (the first remedy under Gut-Toxin & Die-Off Tools: a zeolite powder taken in water, and a fermented juice)
a1-ferment-sec.for: a reader learns which ferment to use and how; the first paragraph is settled and stays; read the second (from "The ZHoly3O ferment contains")
a1-ferment-sec.moment: you are about to take a psychedelic, or to sit with a friend who has, and you want a ferment ready for when the nausea comes; you are deciding what to buy or make

asis-charcoal-sec.heading: Activated Charcoal (the second remedy under Gut-Toxin & Die-Off Tools, after ZeoCharge & Ferment, a zeolite powder taken in water)
asis-charcoal-sec.for: a reader learns when to use activated charcoal for a trip with a toxic gut, and when to use zeolite instead; read all three paragraphs
asis-charcoal-sec.moment: you are sitting with a friend whose trip has turned sick and toxic, with nausea and a heavy, dirty feeling in the gut; you have charcoal and zeolite on hand and are deciding which to give
